name: Fighter
ability: Each round, you can nominate a second time. It can not be the same person as your first nomination.

name: Bard
ability: You start knowing 1 in-play Townsfolk. If you were mad that you were this character, you gain their ability when they die.

name: Cleric
ability: Once per game during the day, privately ask the Storyteller any yes/no question.

name: Druid
ability: Once per game at night, you can resurrect a dead character. They are feral.

name: Monk
ability: Each night*,  choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.

name: Paladin
ability: On the second night, choose a player to protect for the rest of the game. If they would die, you die instead.

name: Warlock
ability: You register as evil but you are good.

name: Wizard
ability: At the beginning of the game, choose 1 spell from the grimoire to memorize. You may cast it once.

name: Sorcerer
ability: At the beginning of the game, you will be given 1 spell. You may cast it twice with a maximum once per round.

name: Hunter
ability: If you are killed by the demon, you will be shown 2 players of which 1 is the demon.

name: Rogue
ability: One time at night, you may kill someone. If they are good, you die as well.

name: Golem
ability: You may only nominate once per game. When you do, if the nominee is not the Demon, they die.

name: Unicorn
ability: You can only be killed if a minion is dead.

name: Elemental
ability: Someone at random may die.

name: Sprite
ability: Once per game, a dead player might be resurrected but they are poisoned.

name: Ettin
ability: Each night*, you may choose an alive player (except the demon) to eat. They register as dead. On the following night they are regurgitated.

name: Succubus
ability: On the first night, choose a good player. Each night, you may tell that player who they are mad about having to nominate that day. They must make a convincing case.

name: Revenant
ability: Each night while dead, you may possess a player. That player is silenced, you have their abilities, and can nominate/vote in their stead. If the player is executed, you lose this ability. You may not possess the same player 2 days in a row.

name: Doppelganger
ability: On the second night, pick a good player. You have that player's character ability and register as that character. You are still evil.

name: Beholder
ability: Each night*, you may choose a player to be silenced, feral, or poisoned. The next night they die.

name: Dragon
ability: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If your last choice was no-one, choose 3 players tonight.

name: Lich
ability: On the first night, select an evil person to hold your phylactery. You die if the person holding your phylactery dies. Each night, you may kill someone. Whomever is holding the phylactery can choose to give it to another evil player.

name: Vampire
ability: Each night, choose a player to bite. They are poisoned. On the following night, they die or become evil and feral.
